name: seated wrist ulnar deviator and flexor stretch
description: A seated wrist stretch for the inner forearm and the little finger side of the wrist.
instructions: Sit tall and extend one arm forward with the palm facing up.
Use the other hand to bend the wrist back and tilt it toward the thumb side until the forearm stretches.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
